messages:
Alex Chen: Quick pre-oncall handoff — I'm grabbing dinner in 15. Leaving a short checklist and a couple of FYIs so the person taking over can sanity-check access and tooling. TL;DR: VPN, pager test, kube/ssh creds, runbook links.

Tess Walker: Thanks — I'll take. Can you paste the runbook link and any quick creds notes? Also is PagerDuty test id the same as last week? :thumbsup:

Alex Chen: Runbook: https://confluence.redwood.ai/runbooks/oncall/pre-oncall-checklist (follow the top section "Access smoke tests"). PagerDuty service id for infra oncall is svc_infra_04. Test command we use: `pd send_test --service-id=svc_infra_04 --key=$PD_API_KEY` (replace env var with your PD key).

Samir Patel: Quick VPN note — if you haven't already, do `okta-aws login` then `openvpn --config ~/vpn/redwood.prod.ovpn`. MFA required. If someone gets a 403 for kube, check `kubectl config get-contexts` and make sure context is `prod-cluster`.

Jin Park: SSH to the jumpbox: `ssh -i ~/.ssh/oncall_id_rsa ubuntu@jumpbox.prod.redwood.internal`. If keys not present, request via people-ops with subject "oncall-key-provision" (they've been pretty quick).

Alex Chen: FYI: we're running a small traffic experiment on inference-api at 18:30 PT that may increase error-rates slightly for short windows (canary ramp). If you see a spate of 503s, check the canary route in the console first before promoting alert. Runbook section: "Canary & fallback" has the rollback steps.

Tess Walker: Got it. On PD test — doing now. `pd send_test --service-id=svc_infra_04` -> succeeded. Also verified I can escalate to oncall group. :white_check_mark:

Samir Patel: I can confirm I can `kubectl -n infra logs -f deploy/inference-api` from the jumpbox. Also sanity-checked KV cache redis: `redis-cli -h redis-prod -p 6379 ping` -> PONG.

Jin Park: One more: metrics alerting uses the prometheus read-only token; if grafana shows a 401, run `aws ssm get-parameter --name "/prod/grafana/read_only_token" --with-decryption` (you need iam-sre role). I added that to the runbook as a note.

Tess Walker: Everything looks good on my side. I'm handing over pager. Stepping into rotation at 18:05 PT. Alex, enjoy dinner!

oncall-bot: Reminder: Oncall handoff recorded — PagerDuty: svc_infra_04 assigned to Tess Walker at 1951237950. If you need to annotate handoff, reply here.

Alex Chen: Thanks all. Small checklist I ran (copying here):
- VPN: success
- SSH to jumpbox: success
- Pager test: success
- Kubectl context: prod-cluster OK
- Redis ping: PONG
- Canary note: scheduled 18:30 PT

Tess Walker: Copy. I'll watch the canary ramp and keep the team posted if anything noisy. Ping me in #eng-oncall if you need me before 21:00 PT.

Samir Patel: Leaving a quick tip for whoever is on next: if you need to recreate the local kv-cache during a rack swap, use `scripts/kv_restore.sh --backup s3://oncall-backups/kv/$(date +%F)` — it waits for healthy nodes before writing.

Jin Park: Adding a small security note: if you see reauth loops after VPN, try clearing cached okta cookies: `rm -rf ~/.okta && okta login` — saved me earlier.

Tess Walker: Thanks everyone. Signing oncall. :raised_hands:
